title: Haze4K development local-action proxy predictability
rationale: The isolated Haze4K development oracle established large spatial headroom beyond a GT-privileged per-image uniform action, but that headroom is non-deployable. This route asks the next necessary question without designing a module: can a low-capacity predictor using only the hazy image, fixed official output, and frozen decoder features select local keep, weaken, or strengthen actions out of scene? Five outer folds hold out entire canonical clear scenes; all target construction, alpha selection, and conservative threshold selection remain inside each outer training partition. The decisive result is OOF image replay, not tile classification. It must improve the official keep output, beat the same predictor collapsed to one image-uniform action, beat a shuffled-target falsification control, and pass scene-level PSNR, SSIM, and color tail-harm gates. Candidate-confirmation data, NH-HAZE, module construction, and network training remain prohibited.

scientific_contract.question: On the isolated 100-scene Haze4K official-test development partition, can a low-capacity proxy using only deployment-visible hazy input, fixed official prediction, and frozen official decoder features select spatial keep, weaken, or strengthen actions that produce material and safe OOF scene-level restoration benefit beyond no adjustment and beyond the identical predictor collapsed to one uniform image action?

intervention.primary_variable: five-fold outer-scene-cross-fitted spatial bounded action selected by a weighted low-capacity multi-output ridge proxy
intervention.reference: official ConvIR-B keep output; co-primary spatial-specificity reference is the identical proxy area-averaged to one uniform action per image
intervention.matched_budget: one frozen official ConvIR-B inference per each of 400 nested variants; all primary, uniform, shuffled-target, observable-only, and input-only policies use the same prediction, action set, folds, and OOF images; no network or module training
fixed_factors: only the isolated 100-scene development_screening asset is delivered; the protected 150-scene candidate_confirmation asset is absent
exact parent COMPLETED_GATE_PASS authorizing HAZE4K_TEST_LOCAL_ACTION_PROXY_PREDICTABILITY
official haze4k-base.pkl SHA-256 6f42037d57a4e3de3a10ac0ab909d66a3415864a19433c29204a975f4efa4088
official ConvIR-B base graph with 8,630,665 frozen parameters and strict checkpoint load
action formula clip(hazy plus scale times official_prediction minus hazy, 0, 1)
action set keep 1.0, weaken 0.8, strengthen 1.2 on origin-aligned 32-pixel tiles
GT target is the clipped normalized per-tile RGB-MSE advantage of weaken and strengthen relative to keep and is computed only for training targets and scoring
outer split is five deterministic 20-scene folds; all four haze variants for a canonical clear scene remain in one fold
within each outer fold, four deterministic scene folds select ridge alpha from 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0 and action threshold from 0, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02, 2.0
inner selection admits only configurations with scene PSNR-harm prevalence at most 0.05 and maximizes the fixed sum of spatial-minus-keep and spatial-minus-uniform mean delta PSNR
threshold 2.0 is a deterministic keep-only fallback because predicted normalized utilities are clipped to [-1,1]
primary proxy input is 40 fixed local moments of hazy image, official prediction, and their residual plus 64 mean/std moments from frozen Decoder[2] features
ridge rows are pixel-area weighted and normalized so every canonical scene and each of its four variants contribute equally
same-predictor uniform control area-averages the two predicted action utilities over each image before applying the identical threshold once
shuffled-target control permutes paired action-utility target rows within the outer training partition and refits the identical ridge using the already inner-selected alpha and threshold
observable-only and hazy-input-only feature families use the same outer folds, selected alpha, selected threshold, action set, and OOF images as descriptive ablations
right and bottom boundary tiles use valid pixels only and are never independent groups
four nested variants are averaged within canonical clear scene before equal-weight scene inference
PSNR is primary utility; RGB SSIM and mean absolute RGB channel-bias are safety metrics
20,000 paired scene bootstrap resamples with seeds 20260726, 20260727, and 20260728; two-sided 95 percent Wilson intervals for prevalence gates
all decisive utility claims form a conjunction, so no candidate can pass by selecting only one favorable contrast

primary_estimand.metric: joint evidence that the lower 95 percent scene-bootstrap bounds for OOF spatial-minus-keep, spatial-minus-same-predictor-uniform, and spatial-minus-shuffled-target delta PSNR each reach +0.10 dB; the Wilson lower bound for scenes gaining at least +0.10 dB over keep reaches 0.20; and every frozen harm upper bound remains below 0.10
primary_estimand.aggregation: compute OOF variant metrics after all selection and fitting, average four variants within canonical clear scene, then equal-weight paired inference across 100 scenes

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Any positive OOF result may reflect prediction of content-dependent RGB-MSE residual corrections, synthetic Haze4K regularities, the official checkpoint's calibration, the chosen decoder representation, hard 32-pixel tiling, or the three selected scales rather than a physical haze mechanism. Cross-fitted output-space predictability does not prove that a trainable network-internal module can reproduce the actions, preserve perceptual quality, or transfer to real haze.
disabled_actions: delivering or accessing the protected 150-scene candidate-confirmation asset
accessing NH-HAZE or any sealed external validation data
training or selecting a network module, changing ConvIR-B weights, or claiming this ridge proxy is the final method
using GT-derived targets, demand, oracle actions, or error maps as OOF test inputs or deployment inputs
selecting features, alpha, threshold, action set, tile size, metric, or safety margin after outer-test outcomes are observed
claiming tile action accuracy alone establishes restoration utility
claiming the selected feature family identifies a causal or physical haze mechanism
treating variants, tiles, pixels, or clear aliases as independent statistical units
automatically continuing into module implementation, confirmation, or NH-HAZE after PASS

precision_contract.rationale: All 100 independent development scenes are used exactly once OOF. The worst-case 95 percent prevalence half-width target 0.098 requires 100 scenes and applies to the decisive benefit and harm prevalence gates; four variants and all tiles remain nested. Mean-delta bootstrap precision is reported from the same 100 paired scene values.

capability.production_path_statement: The exact official Haze4K ConvIR-B graph is strict-loaded and frozen; the exact Decoder[2] hook, deployment-visible tile moments, GT-only target construction, weighted ridge, nested scene selection, conservative thresholding, spatial and uniform action replay, RGB MSE/PSNR, RGB SSIM, color-bias, scene aggregation, bootstrap, Wilson, shuffled control, and finalizer paths are exercised. A protected-data-free 100-scene, 400-variant, representative-tile synthetic probe checks the formal row count and projected five-fold bound.

precision.estimand: scene-level OOF material-benefit and safety-harm prevalence
precision.source_reference: Worst-case Bernoulli standard deviation 0.5 fixed analytically; all 100 canonical development scenes are scored once OOF and four haze variants or tiles do not increase independent n.
